hero.title: Zone Management Runbook
hero.subtitle: Operational guide for managing infrastructure zones in the controlplane

warning.title: Zone is Root Topology
warning.desc: Zone is the root infrastructure unit. All dataplane nodes, services, and workloads are anchored to a zone. Changes to zone status or services have blast radius across all workloads running on that zone. Always follow the runbook and have a rollback plan.

create.title: Creating a New Zone
prerequisites: Admin API key with valid MFA
Zone code must be unique (e.g., us-east-1, edge-hcm-1)
Geographic location must be selected from the autocomplete list
At least one service must be enabled (hypervisor, storage, mail, k8s, or ai)
steps: Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Add Zone
Zone is created with status planned
create.note: New zones always start in planned status. Status cannot be set during creation. Transition to active after dataplane registration.

status_transitions.title: Zone Status Transitions
status_transitions.planned_to_active_desc: Zone is ready to serve traffic. Dataplane must be registered first.
status_transitions.active_to_draining_desc: Gracefully drain workloads. No new workloads accepted, existing ones continue.
status_transitions.active_to_maintenance_desc: Enter maintenance mode. Zone services can be updated. No traffic accepted.
status_transitions.any_to_disabled_desc: Disable zone. All workloads must be migrated away first.
how_to_steps: Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone

service_management.title: Managing Zone Services
service_management.when_desc: Zone services can only be updated when the zone is in planned or maintenance status. This prevents accidental service configuration changes while the zone is actively serving traffic.
workflow_steps: If zone is active, transition to maintenance
Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone → Services
Transition zone back to active when ready
service_management.warning: Disabling a service while workloads are running on it will cause service disruption. Always drain workloads first.

deletion.title: Deleting a Zone
deletion.precondition_1_desc: Transition zone through the state machine to disabled status
deletion.precondition_2_desc: Deregister all dataplane clusters from the zone
deletion.precondition_3_desc: Disable all 5 services (hypervisor, storage, mail, k8s, ai)
workflow_steps: Drain all workloads from the zone
Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone
deletion.warning: Zone deletion is irreversible. Ensure all workloads are migrated and all preconditions are met before proceeding.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.cannot_activate_cause: Zone is in planned status but dataplane is not registered.
troubleshooting.cannot_activate_solution: Register dataplane cluster first. Zone can only transition to active after dataplane is ready.
troubleshooting.cannot_update_services_cause: Zone is in active, draining, or disabled status.
troubleshooting.cannot_update_services_solution: Transition zone to maintenance status first, then update services.
troubleshooting.cannot_delete_cause: One or more preconditions not met (status not disabled, dataplane still attached, or services still enabled).
troubleshooting.cannot_delete_solution: Check all 3 preconditions above. Run through the deletion workflow step-by-step.

zone_management.footer: For additional support, contact the infrastructure team or check the controlplane logs.
